summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan adopting the research report's (c) ruling: a generic, declaration-only obligation in checkpoints/checkpoint-commit.md with a one-line pointer (not a copy) from general-implementation-agent.md, plus a non-blocking derived_probe_run_all call at git-commit-phase.sh's phase-commit site. Plan-time re-derivation added one component the ruling did not reach: git-commit-scoped.sh's V10 already widens scope with derived_probe_output_prefixes while git-commit-phase.sh's Site-2 Containment Self-Check does not, so a regenerated declared surface is dropped before the commit sees it and the new rule would be undone by the script meant to carry it out. All four cited issue-log ids and every carried figure re-derived and confirmed. Plan validates clean with zero warnings.
